name: backlog-triage-active-50
description: Active-sorting variant of backlog-triage: 50% of each repository's entries are passed to the model as examples inside its description and removed from the scored items. Compare with backlog-triage, never with it mixed in.

repo.instructions: Which repository is this entry about? Answer unknown if it does not clearly belong to one.

criteria.scheduler-service: Schedules and runs recurring jobs from manifests; the job, timer and schedule pages, run history and failure notices Examples: "The schedule page should show when each job last ran and whether it passed"; "Add a way to pause one timer for a day without disabling the whole job"; "Job logs are truncated in the web view; let me expand them"; "Document how to write a manifest for a job that needs two timers"; "Jobs that fail twice in a row should be listed at the top of the schedule"
criteria.list-manager: Personal lists: groceries, shopping, to-do, watch, read, invest Examples: "Groceries should remember the store I usually buy each item from"; "When I mark a shopping item bought, move it to a history list with the date"; "Let me reorder items in the to-do list by dragging"; "The invest list needs a column for the target allocation percentage"
criteria.media-library: Organizes, plays and upscales the local video library Examples: "The player should resume an episode where I stopped"; "Upscaled copies take too long to appear; show the render progress"; "Subtitles for foreign films are out of sync after the third episode"; "Add a filter for movies by director on the library page"
criteria.torrent-ui: A web page to add and manage torrents and their limits Examples: "The page refreshes while I am typing the download limit and loses my entry"; "Show the seed ratio next to each torrent"; "Add a per-torrent upload cap in the details view"; "Email me when a torrent finishes, with a link to its page"
criteria.session-viewer: Reviews, resumes and deletes AI assistant sessions Examples: "Resume should open the session in the right working directory"; "Group sessions by repository in the list view"; "The assistant session list shows a schema error for one provider; ignore broken files"; "Bulk delete should ask once and show how many sessions are affected"
criteria.receipt-reader: Scans, parses and reports on receipts and documents Examples: "Receipts from one grocer are read with the totals shifted by a column"; "Add a monthly spending summary by merchant to the report"; "Photos taken sideways should be rotated before text recognition"; "Flag receipts whose line items do not add up to the total"
criteria.local-llm: Runs local language models and benchmarks them Examples: "Compare the small decision models on latency as well as accuracy"; "The benchmark report should include a confusion matrix per task"; "Add a held-out split for the message routing task"; "Serve the large model with a longer context window and see if it still fits in memory"
criteria.network-guard: VPN switching, private tunnels and network status Examples: "Switching country should reconnect the tunnel to my phone as well"; "Show which country the VPN is connected to on the status page"; "The tunnel drops after the laptop sleeps and does not come back"; "Add a button to rotate to a faster server group"
criteria.secret-vault: Passwords Examples: "Cache a retrieved password for a few minutes so scripts do not prompt twice"; "List which tools asked for which credential entry"; "Rotate the stored application password and update everything that uses it"; "The unlock fails if the vault file is on a network share"
criteria.notifier: Alerts Examples: "Send a text message when a backup job fails"; "Alerts should go to every channel, not only the first one that works"; "Reply to a message with a status summary of the machine"; "Rate-limit repeated alerts about the same problem"
criteria.resource-monitor: Machine, drive and repository resource dashboards Examples: "The dashboard should show disk temperature history for the past week"; "Warn me when a drive is close to full"; "Add GPU memory use to the live panel"; "Show which repositories take the most disk space"
criteria.web-ingress: Shared reverse proxy, TLS certificates, client-certificate checks and internal DNS for every home site, including the shared theme and top bar files Examples: "Renew the internal certificate before it expires and deploy it"; "Add a new hostname for the dashboard and publish its DNS record"; "Only devices with the client certificate should reach the admin sites"; "List every internal site with its owner and the port behind it"
criteria.photo-archive: Sorts, deduplicates and backs up personal photos Examples: "Find near-duplicate photos from burst shots and keep the sharpest"; "Group photos by event using the capture time and place"; "Thumbnails are blurry for portrait photos after import"
criteria.book-catalog: Catalogs ebooks and audiobooks, fetches covers and metadata Examples: "Fetch the series name and number for each book automatically"; "Audiobooks should show the total listening time"; "Merge two editions of the same book into one entry"
criteria.music-player: Plays the local music collection Examples: "Gapless playback between tracks of a live album"; "Show lyrics next to the track that is playing"; "Shuffle should avoid repeating an artist twice in a row"
criteria.budget-tracker: Tracks accounts, budgets and spending by category Examples: "Split one transaction across two categories"; "Warn me when a category is at 80 percent of its monthly budget"; "Import the bank's CSV export and skip transactions already seen"
criteria.tax-helper: Collects documents and figures for the yearly tax return Examples: "Remind me which forms are still missing for this year"; "Total the deductible expenses from the receipts folder"; "Keep last year's return next to this year's for comparison"
criteria.job-tracker: Tracks job applications, deadlines and follow-ups Examples: "Show applications that have had no reply for two weeks"; "Add a deadline reminder three days before it is due"; "Record which version of the CV went with each application"; "Sort open positions by deadline"
criteria.resume-builder: Builds the CV and cover letters from templates Examples: "Letters should pick up the company name from the posting"; "Add a one-page version of the CV"; "Highlight skills that match the posting's requirements"
criteria.home-sensors: Reads temperature, power and door sensors around the house Examples: "Chart the living room temperature for the last month"; "Tell me when the garage door has been open for ten minutes"; "Log power use of the freezer separately"
criteria.backup-runner: Schedules, verifies and prunes backups of the machines and the phone Examples: "Verify the newest backup by restoring one random file"; "Prune weekly snapshots older than a year but keep the first of each month"; "Back up the phone photos nightly while it charges"; "Show how much space each backup set uses"
criteria.phone-sync: Shares files with the phone and syncs photos over the home network Examples: "Show the last sync time for each folder"; "Pick which folders on the phone are shared"; "Large videos stall the transfer over weak wifi"
criteria.router-config: Configures and audits the home router and firewall rules Examples: "List every open port and the device behind it"; "Back up the router settings before each change"; "Block a device from the internet after midnight"
criteria.stock-watcher: Fetches quotes and analyses holdings Examples: "Show the cost basis next to the current price"; "Alert when a holding drops more than 8 percent in a day"; "Chart the allocation by sector"
criteria.blog-site: Static personal website and its build pipeline Examples: "Generate a tag page for every tag used in posts"; "The build fails when a post has no title"; "Add an RSS feed for new posts"
criteria.diagram-tool: Renders architecture diagrams and checks the docs for drift Examples: "Warn when a diagram mentions a service the code no longer has"; "Render the same diagram in light and dark colours"; "Add a legend to every generated diagram"
criteria.unknown: Does not clearly belong to any listed repository
